pr.body:
When a known direct unit terminal receiver obtains and discards one same-D root reference before its ordinary scope closes, CHECK and the public five-step owner proof already succeed, but the C17 consumer rejects the call. Reuse the existing discarded-reference classification and full reference/world validation inside the exact authenticated owner call/body, then emit the original unit terminal teardown.

The supported family is one root-reference binding followed by unit within the same-D read scope, followed by the existing four teardown operations. The named four-step and zero-prefix LiveTail controls are retained; this does not declare preservation for every source-valid four-step body or additional vacuous scopes. Callee payload projection/use, non-unit return, public issuers and ownership rules are outside this change.

Adds ten focused CTests: three genuine public-owned cases, five original authority/loan negatives, one artifact-authentication case and one native integration case covering real zero and H0/H1/H2.

This commit has sole parent `1a32f87f1007db8e8c11dc375a6b7416a35adbc7` and tree `a7e0561c7b57e03330b1d1d91c90300dd093f938`, exactly the reviewed local `58245a24e047280304443258b2cfc8a540c9202a` tree. All 15 changed paths and all 7,452 tree entries match, including modes and blobs.

Validation: prior fixed-code Clang/ASan verification and 21 selected native worlds; C1230 separately verified the final formatted source under GCC 14.2.0 Release with fortification and strict diagnostics, with 32 selected invocations and frozen C17/API/CLI bytes. Original FIRST/RED evidence remains intact. This publication phase runs one natural FULL/PARTIAL/EARLY CI set and repeats no local build or test campaign.

Refs #1535 (C1223/C1230/C1236). DRAFT HOLD for Coordination; reduced library-author and ordinary-safe-caller UB audit locality remains unmeasured.
